page.overview:
Who is Damian Falco?

Damian Falco is a fictional National Security Agency (NSA) Chief and ally in the 2002 James Bond film, Die Another Day, portrayed by late American actor Michael Madsen.

Damian Falco was one of the top-ranking operatives of the NSA who, along with Jinx, provided assistance to MI6 as the growing threat by Zao and Gustav Graves grew dire. He first seen when exchanging Zao for Bond in North Korea. He is later present in a bunker near the demilitarised zone (DMZ) between North Korea and South Korea when Graves uses Icarus to destroy the minefield between the two countries. During this time, Falco is upset at M that one of MI6 agent Miranda Frost was revealed to be the one who gave up Bond in North Korea, although M counters that none of these events would've been possible had someone brought up that Frost and Graves were on the same fencing team together. Falco ordered the launch of an ASAT to intercept Icarus, but it was destroyed by the satellite. MI6 agent Bond and NSA agent Jinx successfully board Graves' plane and kill him, stopping the Icarus satellite. After the destruction, Falco casually lights a cigarette, ignoring M's disapproving glare.
